title: Jeweled Crispy Syrian Tripe Stew
description: A winey, crispy, one-pot Syrian dish featuring tripe, poached to perfection with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: tripe
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the cleaned and cut tripe to the pot, stirring to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Pour in the red wine, beef broth, turmeric, paprika, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Remove the lid and continue to simmer for an additional 30 minutes, or until the tripe is crispy and the liquid has reduced slightly.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
